{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes bottom before model predicts",
    "Sentiment turning positive correlates with model undershooting true prices, as model uses lagged sentiment indicators",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes undershootment when prices continue trending away from model's reversion to mean",
    "Correctly predicting price declines requires recognizing that model optimism delay causes late entry into downtrends",
    "Sentiment analysis helps but model doesn't fully incorporate sentiment momentum, leading to forecast discrepancies",
    "Price level bias: model underestimates extreme values in both directions by approximately 1-2% relative magnitude",
    "Forecast accuracy degrades when sentiment shifts abruptly, as model smooths out these changes"
] }
